newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce gets Dfl 50 mln development subsidy.
newsitem.headline: Oce gets Dfl 50 mln development subsidy.

text.p: Photocopier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV said on Tuesday the Dutch Economics Ministry had awarded it a 50 million guilder subsidy over the next five years to develop a new inkjet technology.
The project will require a total investment of 225 million guilders. Part of the research will be contracted out to Dutch research institutes, Oce said in a statement.
By the beginning of the next century, printers with the new technology should be able to produce prints in large formats, full colour, short print-runs and high quality.
The inkjet colour printers which are currently available are relatively slow, have a moderate printing quality and lose much of their speed when printing in a high-quality mode, Oce said.
